newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOXING-KAWASHIMA BEATS SOSA TO RETAIN WBC SUPER-FLYWEIGHT TITLE.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-KAWASHIMA BEATS SOSA TO RETAIN WBC SUPER-FLYWEIGHT TITLE.

text.p: Hiroshi Kawashima of Japan stopped Domingo Sosa of the Dominican Republic in the second round on Saturday to retain his World Boxing Council (WBC) super-flyweight title.
Kawashima pinned Sosa to the ropes with a flurry of blows before referee Laurence Cole stepped in to stop the fight after two minutes 15 seconds of the second round.
It was the sixth title defence for Kawashima, 26, who extended his record to 20 victories, with 14 knockouts, against two losses and one draw.
Kawashima, who first won the title from Jose Luis Bueno of Mexico in May 1994, last defended it against Mexico's Cecilio Espino in April.
The 33-year-old Sosa, ranked eighth in the WBC list, was making his third attempt at a world title. His record now stands at 28-5.
